Can you compare your two most popular options and tell me which is better for me?
Two of our most popular choices for everyday riding are the Polygon Path 3 ($699.99 USD) and the Polygon Heist 2 ($899.99 USD):
• Polygon Path 3 ($699.99 USD): Features a lightweight alloy frame and rigid fork with a Shimano CUES 1x9 drivetrain and hydraulic disc brakes. It is built purely for fast, efficient, and low-maintenance urban commuting on paved roads and city streets.
• Polygon Heist 2 ($899.99 USD): Features an SR Suntour suspension fork and a Shimano 1x8 drivetrain. The front suspension absorbs bumps, making it a better option if your daily routes include rough pavement, gravel paths, or light trails.
If your daily ride is strictly on smooth city roads, the Polygon Path 3 offers fantastic value and a lighter setup. If you need extra comfort on uneven terrain or light trails, the Polygon Heist 2 is the more versatile pick.
